rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3BA label, but the image is somewhat indistinct and the response overstates visibility of a clearly defined ICM and cohesive TE; expansion/thinned zona comments are reasonable.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status well, though some links to embryo quality are somewhat speculative.

Overall logical and structured, with a plausible prognosis estimate, but a few claims are not tightly supported (e.g., maturity-rate inference, stress/former smoking effects, TE being 'most predictive' stated too strongly).

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer and avoiding routine PGT-A at age 20, but ERA after one failure, luteal estradiol suggestion, growth hormone/androgen priming, and calling eSET 'mandatory' are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested interventions are more speculative than standard and could be better prioritized.
